Truecrypt allows two passwords, one of which decrypts one section of your encrypted block, the other decrypts another. With the first key, the second section just appears as unallocated space, and it is impossible to prove that you were even running it in this two-password mode in the first place. The second key is of course the one that actually has the protected data on it, which is aware of the first block and avoids writing over it.
